lessons.title: Build: The One-Second Pendulum Clock II — Calibrate
lessons.focus: Adjust length against a clock over 5 minutes; temperature and wind effects; log drift; name your clock.
lessons.advanced: Clock gains 2 s per 10 min: compute the length correction needed, with direction.

lessons.title: How to Pump a Swing Higher
lessons.focus: Standing-squatting timing pumps energy in; parametric pumping felt on a playground swing; timing is everything.
lessons.advanced: Explain pumping as changing effective length twice per cycle; where does the added energy come from?

lessons.title: Resonance: Small Pushes, Big Swings
lessons.focus: Push at the natural frequency; shaky bridge stories, wine-glass legend, boda bouncing on corrugations; damping as the cure.
materials: two pendulums on a shared string
lessons.advanced: Two coupled pendulums: explain energy transfer when lengths match, and detuning when they don't.

lessons.title: Damping: The Shock Absorber's Job
lessons.focus: Swings stop by air + friction; test a mass on rubber with and without a card damper; boda shocks bounce-test.
lessons.advanced: A bounce-test corner settles in 1.5 vs 4 cycles after shock service: explain what changed energetically.

lessons.title: Springs Oscillate Too: Mass on a Rubber Strip
lessons.focus: Period vs hanging mass measured; heavier = slower here (unlike pendulum); T∝√m pattern.
lessons.advanced: Plot T² vs m; use the gradient with T=2π√(m/k) to extract your strip's spring constant k.

lessons.title: Build: A Stick Metronome
lessons.focus: Inverted pendulum with sliding weight: slide up for slow, down for fast; calibrate beats per minute for music.
lessons.advanced: Explain with the physical-pendulum idea why moving mass up slows the beat.

lessons.title: Sloshing Water: Basins, Tanks and Bores
lessons.focus: Slosh a basin; natural slosh period vs basin size; why tankers have baffles; seiche on a lake teaser.
lessons.advanced: Explain why baffles raise damping and shift frequency; design a baffle layout for a pickup water tank.

lessons.title: Buildings That Sway
lessons.focus: Flexible vs stiff; Rift Valley earthquake awareness; water tanks on towers act like pendulums; model with sticks and clay.
lessons.advanced: Tall flexible vs short stiff model on the shake table: relate survival to natural frequency mismatch.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Pendulum Olympics
lessons.focus: Stations: predict the period, tune to a target, coupled-pendulum demo, damping race; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Championship: specify a pendulum to keep Nairobi time within 30 s/day; show the design math.
